findings.claim: A stale host admission leaves the UAR approval unresolved, so the run can remain blocked waiting for a decision that will never be delivered.
findings.evidence: In `recordAndResolve`, `bridge.recordHumanDecision(...)` returning false immediately throws `uar_approval_stale` before calling `resolve`; the caller only emits an error in the catch path. Acceptance criterion 2.3 requires decision acknowledgments and delivery failures to be correlated and 2.4 requires recovery/error states, but this path neither rejects nor resolves the pending UAR approval.
findings.suggested_fix: When `recordHumanDecision` returns false, also resolve the UAR approval as rejected or explicitly cancel the pending approval/run before surfacing the stale-approval error.
